The time attestation is carried inside a countersignature of a signed envelope; the evidence-bundle suite exercises it there (bundle-valid-trusted-time and eight refusals), but no manifest vector is a bare time attestation, so the schema root has no standalone witness in this denominator.

unit_exclusions.justification: Schema-shadowed: the DCMP-2 response conditional refuses every admit without an authorization object, so schema invalidity, which takes precedence (DCMP2-043), is always the primary finding of an artifact that violates this rule. conformance/manifest.json records it under schema_shadowed_rules as the secondary finding of dcmp2-invalid-admit-without-authority; the schema unit it shadows is covered.

Schema-shadowed: the DCMP-2 response conditional refuses an authorization object in every response that is not an admit, so schema invalidity, which takes precedence (DCMP2-043), is always the primary finding of an artifact that violates this rule. conformance/manifest.json records it under schema_shadowed_rules as the secondary finding of dcmp2-invalid-deny-with-authority; the schema unit it shadows is covered.

No artifact can fail this enum alone, so it has no negative witness: the array holds exactly six unique items and six contains constraints require each of the six enumerated responsibilities, so a value outside the enum always also leaves one contains constraint unmet, and removing the enum does not make the artifact valid. claim-valid-published-example is its positive witness, and the contains constraints refuse every artifact the enum would refuse.

unit_rules: Each schema root; each oneOf/anyOf alternative; each if predicate arm plus a present else arm; each enum keyword; each active semantic rule. The wire, extension-value, claim and assessment document schemas are included. A unit exclusion names its reason.
